name: ITI Electrician Basic Theory 2026 - Practice Test 1

questions.question: What is the unit of electrical resistance?
questions.hint: Ohm is the SI unit of electrical resistance.

questions.question: According to Ohm's Law, current (I) is equal to:
questions.hint: I = V / R, where V is voltage and R is resistance.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure electric current?
questions.hint: An ammeter is used to measure electric current.

questions.question: Which of the following is an insulator?
questions.hint: Rubber is an insulator, meaning it does not conduct electricity.

questions.question: What is the standard household AC frequency in India?
questions.hint: India uses a standard grid frequency of 50 Hz.

questions.question: Which acid is used as an electrolyte in a lead-acid battery?
questions.hint: Dilute Sulphuric Acid (H2SO4) is used as an electrolyte in lead-acid accumulator cells.

questions.question: Which device is used to convert AC voltage to DC voltage?
questions.hint: A rectifier converts Alternating Current (AC) into Direct Current (DC).

questions.question: A transformer works on which type of electrical supply?
questions.hint: Transformers rely on electromagnetic induction which requires a changing magnetic field produced by AC.

questions.question: What is the unit of electrical capacitance?
questions.hint: The Farad (F) is the standard unit of capacitance.

questions.question: Which semiconductor element is most commonly used in manufacturing electronic components?
questions.hint: Silicon is the most popular semiconductor material due to its temperature stability.

questions.question: Which law states that induced electromotive force is proportional to the rate of change of magnetic flux?
questions.hint: Faraday's Law describes the generation of EMF by changing magnetic fields.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to test the insulation resistance of wiring installations?
questions.hint: A Megger is a high-resistance megohmmeter used to test insulation cables.

questions.question: What is the color of the earth/ground wire in standard 3-core cables in India?
questions.hint: Green (or green-yellow stripes) denotes the safety earth connection.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure the specific gravity of battery electrolyte?
questions.hint: A hydrometer measures the density of liquids relative to water, testing battery charge levels.

questions.question: What is the function of a choke in a traditional fluorescent tube light circuit?
options: Limit current and induce starting strike voltage
questions.hint: The choke limits running current and induces a high voltage kick to strike the gas discharge.
